title: Closing Department Standard: Closing Disclosure Receipt and Waiting Periods Before Consummation of a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Standard.** The initial Closing Disclosure on a Mortgage Loan File must reach the borrower before consummation.

**Closing Disclosure waiting period.** Consummation may take place only on or after the end of the waiting period that starts on the date the borrower received the Closing Disclosure. Specific business days are counted forward from the received date of the latest Closing Disclosure that started a waiting period, which is day zero; consummation may occur on the last day of the count. The count is the program's number of specific business days between receipt of the Closing Disclosure and consummation. Here a specific business day is every calendar day except Sundays and the US federal public holidays.

**Seven-day period from the initial Loan Estimate.** Consummation may also take place only on or after the end of the seven-day period that starts on the initial Loan Estimate's issued date. Specific business days are counted forward from the issued date of the initial Loan Estimate, which is day zero; consummation may occur on the seventh such day.

**Corrected Closing Disclosures.** A corrected Closing Disclosure issued before consummation starts a new waiting period only when the APR rises by more than the program's regular-transaction APR tolerance (the irregular-transaction tolerance for an irregular transaction) over the APR last disclosed, when the loan program changes, or when a prepayment penalty is added; any other change is disclosed on a corrected Closing Disclosure given at or before consummation without a new wait. A decrease in APR never starts a new wait. When a new wait applies and the scheduled closing date falls inside it, the closing must be rescheduled.

Both periods are read from the file's disclosure history — the received date of the Closing Disclosure and the issued date of the initial Loan Estimate — and both must be satisfied.

## Earliest consummation, worked through (hypothetical dates, no holidays)

| Event | Date | Counting | Earliest consummation under this period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closing Disclosure received (3-day count) | Thursday | Friday 1, Saturday 2, Sunday skipped, Monday 3 | Monday |
| Initial Loan Estimate issued (7-day count) | Monday | Tuesday 1 … Saturday 5, Sunday skipped, Monday 6, Tuesday 7 | Tuesday of the following week |

The later of the two dates governs, because consummation must satisfy both periods.

## Which corrections restart the wait

| Change on the corrected Closing Disclosure | New waiting period |
|---|---|
| APR rises by more than 0.125 percentage points on a regular transaction (0.25 on an irregular one) | yes |
| APR rises by no more than that tolerance | no |
| APR decreases | no |
| Loan program changes | yes |
| Prepayment penalty added | yes |
| Any other change | no — disclosed at or before consummation without a new wait |
